/** @OnlyCurrentDoc */
// Tip Fair for Google Sheets \u00b7 https://tipfair.facilo.es
// Paste this whole file into Extensions > Apps Script (Code.gs), save, and reopen your spreadsheet.
// It only reads and writes the spreadsheet it is installed in. Your tips data never leaves Google.

// Tip Fair core: all pure logic (spec section 6). Runs in Apps Script, in the sidebar and in Node tests.
// Amounts are integer pennies or cents. Hours and points are integer hundredths. Dates are 'yyyy-mm-dd' strings.
var Core = (function () {
  'use strict';

  var MONTHS = ['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'];
  var TYPES = ['Card', 'Cash', 'Service charge', 'Voucher'];
  var METHODS = ['Equal', 'Hours', 'Points', 'Hours \u00d7 points'];
  var STAFF_TYPES = ['Worker', 'Agency worker', 'Owner or manager', 'Self-employed'];
  var LANGS = ['English', 'Spanish', 'Polish', 'Portuguese', 'Romanian', 'Italian'];
  var FREE_LIMIT = 5, GRACE_DAYS = 14;

  function pad(n) { return (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n; }
  function err(text) { return { ok: false, error: text }; }

  /* ---------- 6.5 largest remainder ---------- */
  // Splits integer n by integer weights. Exact share e_k = n*w_k/W, worked out with BigInt so nothing rounds early.
  // Ties: larger fraction, then larger exact share, then list order.
  // No BigInt literals (0n): the Apps Script editor's parser refuses them, so the constants are made with BigInt().
  function largestRemainder(n, weights) {
    var ZERO = BigInt(0), ONE = BigInt(1);
    var W = ZERO, N = BigInt(n);
    weights.forEach(function (w) { W += BigInt(w); });
    if (W <= ZERO) return weights.map(function () { return 0; });
    var items = weights.map(function (w, k) {
      var num = N * BigInt(w), fl = num / W, rem = num % W;
      if (rem < ZERO) { fl -= ONE; rem += W; } // floor for negative n
      return { k: k, num: num, floor: fl, rem: rem };
    });
    var L = N;
    items.forEach(function (it) { L -= it.floor; });
    var order = items.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
      if (a.rem !== b.rem) return a.rem > b.rem ? -1 : 1;
      if (a.num !== b.num) return a.num > b.num ? -1 : 1;
      return a.k - b.k;
    });
    for (var i = 0; i < Number(L); i++) order[i].floor += ONE;
    return items.map(function (it) { return Number(it.floor); });
  }

  /* ---------- numbers ---------- */
  // Hours: a number or 'h:mm'. Returns hundredths of an hour, or null.
  function parseHours(v) {
    if (v === '' || v == null) return 0;
    if (typeof v === 'number') return isFinite(v) && v >= 0 ? Math.round(v * 100) : null;
    if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Date]') return Math.round((v.getHours() + v.getMinutes() / 60) * 100);
    var s = String(v).trim(), m = /^(\d+):([0-5]\d)$/.exec(s);
    if (m) return Number(m[1]) * 100 + Math.round(Number(m[2]) * 100 / 60);
    s = s.replace(',', '.');
    if (!/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(s)) return null;
    return Math.round(parseFloat(s) * 100);
  }
  // Points: blank is 1, any number >= 0 up to 2 decimals. Returns hundredths, or null.
  function parsePoints(v) {
    if (v === '' || v == null) return 100;
    var x = typeof v === 'number' ? v : parseFloat(String(v).trim().replace(',', '.'));
    if (!isFinite(x) || x < 0 || !/^\s*\d*([.,]\d*)?\s*$/.test(String(v))) return null;
    return Math.round(x * 100);
  }
  function hundredths(h) { var x = h / 100; return Math.round(x * 100) / 100; }
  // Money from a sheet cell or CSV text. comma: true when the decimal mark is a comma (1.234,56).
  function parseAmount(v, comma) {
    if (typeof v === 'number') return isFinite(v) ? Math.round(v * 100) : null;
    var s = String(v == null ? '' : v).trim().replace(/[\u00a3\u20ac$\s\u00a0]|GBP|EUR/gi, '');
    if (!s) return null;
    var neg = false;
    if (/^\(.*\)$/.test(s)) { neg = true; s = s.slice(1, -1); }
    if (/^[-\u2212]/.test(s)) { neg = true; s = s.slice(1); }
    if (comma) s = s.replace(/\./g, '').replace(',', '.');
    else s = s.replace(/,/g, '');
    if (!/^\d*(\.\d{0,4})?$/.test(s) || s === '' || s === '.') return null;
    var p = Math.round(parseFloat(s) * 100);
    return neg ? -p : p;
  }

  /* ---------- dates ---------- */
  var MON = { jan: 1, feb: 2, mar: 3, apr: 4, may: 5, jun: 6, jul: 7, aug: 8, sep: 9, sept: 9, oct: 10, nov: 11, dec: 12 };
  function iso(y, m, d) {
    if (y < 100) y += 2000;
    var t = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
    if (t.getUTCFullYear() !== y || t.getUTCMonth() !== m - 1 || t.getUTCDate() !== d) return null;
    return y + '-' + pad(m) + '-' + pad(d);
  }
  // order: 'dmy' (default) or 'mdy' only when the venue says so for an ambiguous file. Never guesses mm/dd.
  function parseDate(v, order) {
    if (v == null || v === '') return null;
    if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Date]') return isNaN(v) ? null : iso(v.getFullYear(), v.getMonth() + 1, v.getDate());
    var s = String(v).trim().replace(/[T ]\d{1,2}:\d\d(:\d\d)?(\.\d+)?\s*(Z|[ap]m|[+-]\d\d:?\d\d)?$/i, '').trim(), m;
    if ((m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})$/.exec(s))) return iso(+m[1], +m[2], +m[3]);
    if ((m = /^(\d{1,2})[\/.\-](\d{1,2})[\/.\-](\d{2}|\d{4})$/.exec(s))) return order === 'mdy' ? iso(+m[3], +m[1], +m[2]) : iso(+m[3], +m[2], +m[1]);
    if ((m = /^(\d{1,2})[ \-]([A-Za-z]{3,9})\.?[ \-,]+(\d{4})$/.exec(s))) { var mo = MON[m[2].slice(0, 4).toLowerCase()] || MON[m[2].slice(0, 3).toLowerCase()]; return mo ? iso(+m[3], mo, +m[1]) : null; }
    return null;
  }
  // True when every slash date in the list has day and month both <= 12 and at least one differs (3/4 vs 4/3).
  function ambiguousDates(values) {
    var seen = false, any = false;
    for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
      var s = String(values[i] == null ? '' : values[i]).trim().replace(/[T ]\d{1,2}:\d\d.*$/, '');
      var m = /^(\d{1,2})[\/.\-](\d{1,2})[\/.\-](\d{2}|\d{4})$/.exec(s);
      if (!m) continue;
      any = true;
      if (+m[1] > 12 || +m[2] > 12) return false;
      if (+m[1] !== +m[2]) seen = true;
    }
    return any && seen;
  }
  function addDays(d, n) { var t = new Date(d + 'T12:00:00Z'); t.setUTCDate(t.getUTCDate() + n); return t.toISOString().slice(0, 10); }
  function addYears(d, n) { var y = +d.slice(0, 4) + n, m = +d.slice(5, 7), day = +d.slice(8, 10); return iso(y, m, day) || iso(y, m, day - 1); }
  function lastDay(y, m) { return new Date(Date.UTC(y, m, 0)).getUTCDate(); }
  function monthEnd(d) { var y = +d.slice(0, 4), m = +d.slice(5, 7); return d.slice(0, 8) + pad(lastDay(y, m)); }
  function addMonths(ym, n) { var y = +ym.slice(0, 4), m = +ym.slice(5, 7) - 1 + n; y += Math.floor(m / 12); m = ((m % 12) + 12) % 12; return y + '-' + pad(m + 1); }
  function daysBetween(a, b) { return Math.round((Date.parse(b + 'T12:00:00Z') - Date.parse(a + 'T12:00:00Z')) / 864e5); }
  function d(s, style) {
    if (!s) return '';
    var y = +s.slice(0, 4), m = +s.slice(5, 7), day = +s.slice(8, 10), M = MONTHS[m - 1];
    switch (style) {
      case 'long': return day + ' ' + M + ' ' + y;
      case 'my': return M + ' ' + y;
      case 'mY': return M.slice(0, 3) + ' ' + y;
      case 'm': return M;
      case 'dM': return day + ' ' + M;
      case 'dm': return day + ' ' + M.slice(0, 3);
      default: return day + ' ' + M.slice(0, 3) + ' ' + y;
    }
  }

  /* ---------- 6.7 deadlines ---------- */
  // Great Britain: the end of the month after the month of the earliest tip.
  function gbDeadline(earliest) { var ym = addMonths(earliest.slice(0, 7), 1); return monthEnd(ym + '-01'); }
  function ieStatementBy(payout) { return addDays(payout, 10); }

  /* ---------- money ---------- */
  function money(p, cur) {
    var neg = p < 0, a = Math.abs(p), s = String(Math.floor(a / 100)).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
    return (neg ? '\u2212' : '') + (cur || '\u00a3') + s + '.' + pad(a % 100);
  }
  function plain(p) { return (p < 0 ? '-' : '') + Math.floor(Math.abs(p) / 100) + '.' + pad(Math.abs(p) % 100); }

  /* ---------- 6.1 tips ---------- */
  function inPeriod(t, from, to) { return t.date && t.date >= from && t.date <= to; }
  function tipsTotal(tips, from, to) {
    var total = 0, byType = { Card: 0, Cash: 0, 'Service charge': 0, Voucher: 0 }, n = 0, first = null;
    tips.forEach(function (t) {
      if (!inPeriod(t, from, to)) return;
      var v = t.amount - (t.vat || 0);
      total += v; n++;
      byType[TYPES.indexOf(t.type) > -1 ? t.type : 'Card'] += v;
      if (!first || t.date < first) first = t.date;
    });
    return { total: total, byType: byType, count: n, first: first };
  }

  /* ---------- 6.2 weights ---------- */
  function weight(method, h, p, anyHours) {
    switch (method) {
      case 'Equal': return !anyHours || h > 0 ? 1 : 0;
      case 'Hours': return h;
      case 'Points': return h > 0 ? p : 0;
      default: return h * p; // Hours \u00d7 points
    }
  }

  /* ---------- hours check (5.4) ---------- */
  function checkHours(staff, hours, from, to, monthName) {
    var names = {}, msgs = [], total = 0, people = {};
    staff.forEach(function (s) { names[s.name] = 1; });
    var unknown = {};
    hours.forEach(function (r) {
      if (r.date && (r.date < from || r.date > to)) return;
      if (!names[r.name]) { unknown[r.name] = 1; return; }
      total += r.hours;
      if (r.hours > 0) people[r.name] = 1;
    });
    Object.keys(unknown).forEach(function (n) { msgs.push({ k: 'unknown', name: n, text: '"' + n + '" has hours but isn\'t on the Staff sheet. Add them, or fix the name.' }); });
    staff.forEach(function (s) { if (!people[s.name]) msgs.push({ k: 'none', name: s.name, text: s.name + ' has no hours in ' + monthName + ', so gets no share unless the rule is Equal.' }); });
    return { total: total, people: Object.keys(people).length, unknown: Object.keys(unknown), messages: msgs };
  }

  /* ---------- 6.3, 6.4 split ---------- */
  // o: {tips, staff:[{name, full, group, points, type, lang}], hours:[{date, name, hours}], from, to,
  //     groupsOn, groups:[{name, pct, method}], method, pool: 'period'|'day', tronc}
  function split(o) {
    var tt = tipsTotal(o.tips, o.from, o.to), T = tt.total, R = o.tronc || 0;
    if (R < 0 || R > Math.max(T, 0)) return err('The tronc amount can\'t be more than the tips.');
    var N = T - R;
    if (N <= 0) return err('There are no tips to share in this period.');
    var defs = o.groupsOn ? o.groups : [{ name: 'All staff', pct: 100, method: o.method }];
    var pctSum = 0;
    defs.forEach(function (g) { pctSum += Math.round(Number(g.pct || 0) * 100); });
    if (pctSum !== 10000) return err('Group shares add up to ' + pctSum / 100 + '%. Make them 100%.');
    var known = {};
    o.staff.forEach(function (s) { known[s.name] = 1; });
    var hrs = o.hours.filter(function (r) { return known[r.name] && (!r.date || (r.date >= o.from && r.date <= o.to)); });
    var groups = defs.map(function (g) {
      var people = o.staff.filter(function (s) { return !o.groupsOn || s.group === g.name; }).map(function (s) {
        return { name: s.name, full: s.full || s.name, group: g.name, type: s.type || 'Worker', lang: s.lang || 'English', p: s.points == null ? 100 : s.points, h: 0, w: 0, share: 0 };
      });
      return { name: g.name, pct: Number(g.pct), method: g.method, people: people, pot: 0 };
    });
    var days;
    if (o.pool === 'day') {
      if (hrs.some(function (r) { return !r.date; })) return err('Each-day sharing needs a date on every Hours row.');
      var byDay = {};
      o.tips.forEach(function (t) { if (inPeriod(t, o.from, o.to)) byDay[t.date] = (byDay[t.date] || 0) + t.amount - (t.vat || 0); });
      days = Object.keys(byDay).sort().filter(function (k) { return byDay[k] !== 0; }).map(function (k) { return { date: k, T: byDay[k] }; });
      var tr = largestRemainder(R, days.map(function (x) { return Math.max(x.T, 0); }));
      days.forEach(function (x, i) { x.N = x.T - tr[i]; });
    } else days = [{ date: null, N: N }];
    var pots = groups.map(function () { return 0; });
    for (var di = 0; di < days.length; di++) {
      var day = days[di], hoursOf = {}, any = false;
      hrs.forEach(function (r) { if (!day.date || r.date === day.date) { hoursOf[r.name] = (hoursOf[r.name] || 0) + r.hours; if (r.hours > 0) any = true; } });
      if (day.date && !any && day.N !== 0) return err(Core.d(day.date, 'dm') + ' has tips but no hours. Add hours for that day, or share by the whole period.');
      var anyHours = hrs.length > 0;
      var ws = groups.map(function (g) {
        return g.people.map(function (p) { var h = hoursOf[p.name] || 0; return weight(g.method, h, p.p, anyHours); });
      });
      for (var gi = 0; gi < groups.length; gi++) {
        var sw = ws[gi].reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0);
        if (sw === 0 && groups[gi].pct > 0) return err('Nobody in ' + groups[gi].name + ' has hours in this period. Set its share to 0%, or add hours.');
      }
      var dpots = largestRemainder(day.N, groups.map(function (g) { return Math.round(g.pct * 100); }));
      groups.forEach(function (g, gi2) {
        pots[gi2] += dpots[gi2];
        var s = largestRemainder(dpots[gi2], ws[gi2]);
        g.people.forEach(function (p, k) { p.share += s[k]; p.h += hoursOf[p.name] || 0; p.w += ws[gi2][k]; });
      });
    }
    var sharers = 0, check = 0, people = [];
    groups.forEach(function (g, gi) {
      g.pot = pots[gi];
      g.people.forEach(function (p) { check += p.share; if (p.share > 0) sharers++; people.push(p); });
    });
    if (check !== N) return err('Shares don\'t add up. Please write to support@facilo.es.');
    return { ok: true, T: T, R: R, Tsplit: N, byType: tt.byType, count: tt.count, first: tt.first, groups: groups, people: people, sharers: sharers, days: o.pool === 'day' ? days.length : 0 };
  }

  // 6.10: individual shares need Pro when more than 5 people share.
  function locked(r, pro) { return r.ok && r.sharers > FREE_LIMIT && !pro; }

  function ruleText(o) {
    var defs = o.groupsOn ? o.groups : [{ name: 'All staff', pct: 100, method: o.method }];
    return defs.map(function (g) { return g.name + ' ' + g.pct + '% ' + g.method.toLowerCase().replace(' \u00d7 ', '\u00d7'); }).join('; ') +
      '; ' + (o.pool === 'day' ? 'each day' : 'whole period');
  }

  /* ---------- 6.8 record ---------- */
  var RECORD_COLS = ['Period ID', 'From', 'To', 'Paid on', 'Tips total', 'Card', 'Cash', 'Service charge', 'Voucher', 'Through tronc', 'To workers', 'Rule',
    'Name', 'Group', 'Hours', 'Points', 'Share', 'Finalised at', 'Fingerprint', 'Keep until', 'Note', 'Status'];
  var FP = RECORD_COLS.indexOf('Fingerprint');
  // One row per person with a share. Amounts as decimal text so the sheet shows them and the fingerprint is stable.
  function recordRows(r, o, payout, at) {
    var id = o.from + '_' + o.to, rule = ruleText(o), keep = addYears(payout, 3);
    var rows = r.people.filter(function (p) { return p.share > 0; }).map(function (p) {
      return [id, o.from, o.to, payout, plain(r.T), plain(r.byType.Card), plain(r.byType.Cash), plain(r.byType['Service charge']), plain(r.byType.Voucher),
        plain(r.R), plain(r.Tsplit), rule, p.full, p.group, String(hundredths(p.h)), String(hundredths(p.p)), plain(p.share), at, '', keep, '', ''];
    });
    var fp = fingerprint(rows);
    rows.forEach(function (row) { row[FP] = fp; });
    return rows;
  }
  // Canonical JSON of the block, without Fingerprint, Note and Status. First 16 hex of SHA-256.
  function fingerprint(rows) {
    var canon = rows.map(function (row) { return row.slice(0, FP).map(function (v) { return String(v == null ? '' : v); }); });
    return sha256(JSON.stringify(canon)).slice(0, 16);
  }
  // Groups the Record sheet rows (from row 2, as text) into blocks and checks each fingerprint.
  function readRecord(rows) {
    var blocks = [], cur = null;
    rows.forEach(function (row, i) {
      var r = row.map(function (v) { return v == null ? '' : String(v); });
      if (!r[0]) return;
      var key = r[0] + '|' + r[17];
      // One row per person in a block, so a repeated name starts a new one (two finalises in the same minute).
      if (!cur || cur.key !== key || cur.names[r[12]]) { cur = { key: key, id: r[0], from: r[1], to: r[2], paid: r[3], total: toP(r[4]), tronc: toP(r[9]), toWorkers: toP(r[10]), rule: r[11], at: r[17], fp: r[18], status: r[21], rows: [], names: {}, first: i }; blocks.push(cur); }
      cur.rows.push(r);
      cur.names[r[12]] = 1;
      if (r[21]) cur.status = r[21];
    });
    blocks.forEach(function (b) { b.changed = fingerprint(b.rows) !== b.fp; b.replaced = /^Replaced/.test(b.status); });
    return blocks;
  }
  function toP(s) { var p = parseAmount(s, false); return p == null ? 0 : p; }

  /* ---------- 6.9 record request ---------- */
  function requestRange(q, m1, m2) {
    var minM = addMonths(q.slice(0, 7), -36), maxM = addMonths(q.slice(0, 7), -1), errors = [];
    if (m1 < minM) errors.push({ k: 'min', m: minM, text: 'The months must start no more than 3 years before the request: ' + d(minM + '-01', 'my') + ' or later.' });
    if (m2 > maxM) errors.push({ k: 'max', m: maxM, text: 'The months must have ended before the request date: ' + d(maxM + '-01', 'my') + ' or earlier.' });
    if (m1 > m2) errors.push({ k: 'order', text: 'The first month must come before the last.' });
    return { errors: errors, min: minM, max: maxM, replyBy: addDays(q, 27) };
  }
  // Totals per payout month for one worker, from finalised blocks that weren't replaced.
  function letterRows(blocks, fullName, m1, m2) {
    var months = [], byM = {};
    for (var m = m1; m <= m2; m = addMonths(m, 1)) { months.push(m); byM[m] = { month: m, total: 0, toWorkers: 0, tronc: 0, share: 0, worked: false }; }
    blocks.forEach(function (b) {
      if (b.replaced) return;
      var m = b.paid.slice(0, 7), x = byM[m];
      if (!x) return;
      x.total += b.total; x.toWorkers += b.toWorkers; x.tronc += b.tronc;
      b.rows.forEach(function (r) { if (r[12] === fullName) { x.share += toP(r[16]); x.worked = true; } });
    });
    var rows = months.map(function (m) { return byM[m]; }), sum = { total: 0, toWorkers: 0, tronc: 0, share: 0 };
    rows.forEach(function (x) { sum.total += x.total; sum.toWorkers += x.toWorkers; sum.tronc += x.tronc; sum.share += x.share; });
    // Periods that end in the asked months but are paid after them, so the owner can say where they will show.
    var later = blocks.filter(function (b) { var e = b.to.slice(0, 7); return !b.replaced && e >= m1 && e <= m2 && b.paid.slice(0, 7) > m2; })
      .map(function (b) { return { from: b.from, to: b.to, paid: b.paid }; });
    return { rows: rows, sum: sum, later: later, noShare: rows.filter(function (x) { return !x.worked; }).map(function (x) { return x.month; }) };
  }

  /* ---------- 6.12 CSV ---------- */
  var MAX_CSV = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
  function parseCsv(text) {
    if (text.length > MAX_CSV) return err('That file is over 5 MB. Export a shorter period.');
    if (text.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff) text = text.slice(1);
    var nl = text.search(/\r?\n/), head = nl < 0 ? text : text.slice(0, nl);
    var counts = { ',': 0, ';': 0, '\t': 0 }, q = false;
    for (var i = 0; i < head.length; i++) { var c = head[i]; if (c === '"') q = !q; else if (!q && counts[c] != null) counts[c]++; }
    var sep = counts['\t'] > counts[','] && counts['\t'] >= counts[';'] ? '\t' : counts[';'] > counts[','] ? ';' : ',';
    var rows = [], row = [], f = '', inq = false;
    for (var j = 0; j < text.length; j++) {
      var ch = text[j];
      if (inq) {
        if (ch === '"') { if (text[j + 1] === '"') { f += '"'; j++; } else inq = false; } else f += ch;
      } else if (ch === '"') inq = true;
      else if (ch === sep) { row.push(f); f = ''; }
      else if (ch === '\n' || ch === '\r') { if (ch === '\r' && text[j + 1] === '\n') j++; row.push(f); rows.push(row); row = []; f = ''; }
      else f += ch;
    }
    if (f !== '' || row.length) { row.push(f); rows.push(row); }
    rows = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.some(function (x) { return x.trim() !== ''; }); });
    if (!rows.length) return err('That file is empty.');
    return { ok: true, sep: sep, headers: rows[0].map(function (h) { return h.trim(); }), rows: rows.slice(1) };
  }
  var WORDS = {
    date: ['date', 'created', 'time', 'transaction date'],
    tip: ['tip', 'tips', 'gratuity', 'tip amount'],
    staff: ['staff', 'employee', 'team member', 'server', 'operator'],
    ref: ['reference', 'ref', 'transaction id', 'receipt number', 'receipt', 'payment id', 'id']
  };
  function findCol(headers, words) {
    var low = headers.map(function (h) { return h.toLowerCase().replace(/[_\-]+/g, ' ').replace(/\s*\(.*\)$/, '').trim(); });
    for (var w = 0; w < words.length; w++) { var i = low.indexOf(words[w]); if (i > -1) return i; }
    for (var w2 = 0; w2 < words.length; w2++) {
      for (var k = 0; k < low.length; k++) if (new RegExp('(^|\\s)' + words[w2] + '(\\s|$)').test(low[k])) return k;
    }
    return -1;
  }
  function detectColumns(headers) {
    var m = { date: findCol(headers, WORDS.date), tip: findCol(headers, WORDS.tip), staff: findCol(headers, WORDS.staff), ref: findCol(headers, WORDS.ref) };
    if (m.ref === m.date || m.ref === m.tip) m.ref = -1;
    m.found = m.date > -1 && m.tip > -1;
    return m;
  }
  function mappingKey(headers) { return 'map:' + headers.map(function (h) { return h.toLowerCase(); }).sort().join('|'); }
  // Named tills, matched by their own export headers (fixtures in tests/fixtures).
  var TILLS = [
    { name: 'Square', has: ['date', 'time', 'tip', 'gross sales', 'transaction id'] },
    { name: 'SumUp', has: ['transaction id', 'date', 'tip amount', 'total amount'] },
    { name: 'Zettle', has: ['date', 'receipt number', 'tip', 'staff'] },
    { name: 'Dojo', has: ['transaction date', 'gratuity', 'transaction id'] },
    { name: 'Teya', has: ['transaction date', 'tip amount', 'terminal id'] },
    { name: 'Lightspeed', has: ['date', 'receipt id', 'tips', 'employee'] },
    { name: 'Clover', has: ['payment id', 'tip amount', 'employee', 'payment date'] }
  ];
  function tillName(headers) {
    var low = headers.map(function (h) { return h.toLowerCase().trim(); });
    for (var i = 0; i < TILLS.length; i++) if (TILLS[i].has.every(function (w) { return low.indexOf(w) > -1; })) return TILLS[i].name;
    return '';
  }
  // Turns parsed CSV rows into tips with a mapping {date, tip, staff, ref}. order: 'dmy' | 'mdy'.
  function csvTips(p, map, source, order) {
    var comma = p.sep === ';', out = [], bad = 0;
    p.rows.forEach(function (r) {
      var a = parseAmount(r[map.tip], comma);
      if (a == null || a === 0) return;
      var dt = parseDate(r[map.date], order);
      if (!dt) { bad++; return; }
      out.push({ date: dt, amount: a, type: 'Card', vat: 0, source: source || '', ref: map.ref > -1 ? String(r[map.ref] || '').trim() : '', staff: map.staff > -1 ? String(r[map.staff] || '').trim() : '' });
    });
    var first = null, last = null, total = 0;
    out.forEach(function (t) { total += t.amount; if (!first || t.date < first) first = t.date; if (!last || t.date > last) last = t.date; });
    return { tips: out, count: out.length, total: total, first: first, last: last, bad: bad, ambiguous: order ? false : ambiguousDates(p.rows.map(function (r) { return r[map.date]; })) };
  }
  // Duplicates: same date, amount and reference as a tip already in the sheet (or earlier in the file).
  function dedupe(existing, incoming) {
    var seen = {}, keep = [], skipped = 0;
    function key(t) { return t.date + '|' + t.amount + '|' + (t.ref || ''); }
    existing.forEach(function (t) { seen[key(t)] = 1; });
    incoming.forEach(function (t) { var k = key(t); if (seen[k] && (t.ref || existing.length)) { skipped++; return; } seen[k] = 1; keep.push(t); });
    return { tips: keep, skipped: skipped };
  }

  /* ---------- safety ---------- */
  // Text that Sheets would read as a formula gets a leading apostrophe.
  function safeText(v) { var s = v == null ? '' : String(v); return /^[=+\-@]/.test(s) ? '\'' + s : s; }

  /* ---------- 6.11 licence ---------- */
  // res: Freemius license object or null when offline. lastGood: 'yyyy-mm-dd' of the last good check.
  function licenceState(res, today, lastGood) {
    if (res === null) {
      if (!lastGood) return { pro: false, status: 'offline', left: 0 };
      var left = GRACE_DAYS - daysBetween(lastGood, today);
      return { pro: left > 0, status: 'offline', left: Math.max(0, left) };
    }
    if (!res || res.error) return { pro: false, status: 'wrong' };
    if (res.is_cancelled) return { pro: false, status: 'cancelled' };
    var exp = res.expiration ? String(res.expiration).slice(0, 10) : null;
    if (exp && exp < today) return { pro: false, status: 'expired', expires: exp };
    return { pro: true, status: 'ok', expires: exp };
  }

  /* ---------- SHA-256 (sync, so the same code runs everywhere) ---------- */
  var K256 = [0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5, 0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3,
    0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174, 0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
    0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967, 0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13,
    0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85, 0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
    0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3, 0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208,
    0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2];
  function utf8(s) {
    var out = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
      var c = s.charCodeAt(i);
      if (c >= 0xd800 && c < 0xdc00 && i + 1 < s.length) { c = 0x10000 + ((c - 0xd800) << 10) + (s.charCodeAt(++i) - 0xdc00); }
      if (c < 0x80) out.push(c);
      else if (c < 0x800) out.push(0xc0 | c >> 6, 0x80 | c & 63);
      else if (c < 0x10000) out.push(0xe0 | c >> 12, 0x80 | c >> 6 & 63, 0x80 | c & 63);
      else out.push(0xf0 | c >> 18, 0x80 | c >> 12 & 63, 0x80 | c >> 6 & 63, 0x80 | c & 63);
    }
    return out;
  }
  function sha256(s) {
    var b = utf8(s), l = b.length * 8, H = [0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19], w = new Array(64);
    b.push(0x80);
    while (b.length % 64 !== 56) b.push(0);
    for (var sh = 56; sh >= 0; sh -= 8) b.push(sh >= 32 ? Math.floor(l / Math.pow(2, sh)) & 255 : l >>> sh & 255);
    for (var o = 0; o < b.length; o += 64) {
      for (var t = 0; t < 16; t++) w[t] = b[o + 4 * t] << 24 | b[o + 4 * t + 1] << 16 | b[o + 4 * t + 2] << 8 | b[o + 4 * t + 3];
      for (t = 16; t < 64; t++) {
        var x = w[t - 15], y = w[t - 2];
        var s0 = (x >>> 7 | x << 25) ^ (x >>> 18 | x << 14) ^ x >>> 3, s1 = (y >>> 17 | y << 15) ^ (y >>> 19 | y << 13) ^ y >>> 10;
        w[t] = w[t - 16] + s0 + w[t - 7] + s1 | 0;
      }
      var a = H[0], bb = H[1], c = H[2], dd = H[3], e = H[4], f = H[5], g = H[6], h = H[7];
      for (t = 0; t < 64; t++) {
        var S1 = (e >>> 6 | e << 26) ^ (e >>> 11 | e << 21) ^ (e >>> 25 | e << 7), ch = e & f ^ ~e & g;
        var t1 = h + S1 + ch + K256[t] + w[t] | 0;
        var S0 = (a >>> 2 | a << 30) ^ (a >>> 13 | a << 19) ^ (a >>> 22 | a << 10), mj = a & bb ^ a & c ^ bb & c;
        var t2 = S0 + mj | 0;
        h = g; g = f; f = e; e = dd + t1 | 0; dd = c; c = bb; bb = a; a = t1 + t2 | 0;
      }
      H[0] = H[0] + a | 0; H[1] = H[1] + bb | 0; H[2] = H[2] + c | 0; H[3] = H[3] + dd | 0; H[4] = H[4] + e | 0; H[5] = H[5] + f | 0; H[6] = H[6] + g | 0; H[7] = H[7] + h | 0;
    }
    return H.map(function (v) { return ('0000000' + (v >>> 0).toString(16)).slice(-8); }).join('');
  }
  function uid(spreadsheetId) { return sha256('tipfair:' + spreadsheetId).slice(0, 32); }

  return {
    MONTHS: MONTHS, TYPES: TYPES, METHODS: METHODS, STAFF_TYPES: STAFF_TYPES, LANGS: LANGS, FREE_LIMIT: FREE_LIMIT, GRACE_DAYS: GRACE_DAYS, RECORD_COLS: RECORD_COLS,
    largestRemainder: largestRemainder, parseHours: parseHours, parsePoints: parsePoints, parseAmount: parseAmount, parseDate: parseDate, ambiguousDates: ambiguousDates,
    addDays: addDays, addYears: addYears, addMonths: addMonths, monthEnd: monthEnd, daysBetween: daysBetween, d: d, gbDeadline: gbDeadline, ieStatementBy: ieStatementBy,
    money: money, plain: plain, hundredths: hundredths, tipsTotal: tipsTotal, weight: weight, checkHours: checkHours, split: split, locked: locked, ruleText: ruleText,
    recordRows: recordRows, fingerprint: fingerprint, readRecord: readRecord, requestRange: requestRange, letterRows: letterRows,
    parseCsv: parseCsv, detectColumns: detectColumns, mappingKey: mappingKey, tillName: tillName, csvTips: csvTips, dedupe: dedupe,
    safeText: safeText, licenceState: licenceState, sha256: sha256, uid: uid
  };
})();

// gs/all (group or everyone, then {m} the method and {d} day by day) and the y* lines, with the group in brackets.

// Tip Fair printouts and result checks (spec 5.6 to 5.10). Pure: data in, HTML strings out, so tests can scan them.
// v = venue context: {country: 'GB'|'NI'|'IE', venue, contact, from, to, payout, groupsOn}
var Docs = (function () {
  'use strict';
  var C = typeof Core !== 'undefined' ? Core : require('./core.js');
  var W = typeof I18N !== 'undefined' ? I18N : require('./i18n.js');

  function esc(s) { return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) { return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]; }); }
  function cur(v) { return v.country === 'IE' ? '\u20ac' : '\u00a3'; }
  function num(x) { return String(Math.round(x * 100) / 100); }
  function sub(s, v) { return s.replace('{v}', v.venue).replace('{c}', v.contact || 'your manager'); }

  /* ---------- result checks (5.6) ---------- */
  // Returns [{kind: 'ok'|'warn', text}] in the order shown above the Finalise button.
  function checks(r, v, locked) {
    var out = [{ kind: 'ok', text: 'Shares add up to ' + C.money(r.Tsplit, cur(v)) + ' exactly.' }];
    var month = C.d(v.from, 'm');
    if (v.country === 'GB' && r.first) {
      var D1 = C.gbDeadline(r.first);
      out.push(v.payout > D1
        ? { kind: 'warn', text: 'Tips paid in ' + month + ' must reach staff by ' + C.d(D1, 'long') + '. Your payout date is ' + C.d(v.payout, 'dM') + '.' }
        : { kind: 'ok', text: 'Payout ' + C.d(v.payout, 'dm') + ' is on time. ' + month + ' tips must reach staff by ' + C.d(D1) + '.' });
    }
    if (v.country === 'IE') out.push({ kind: 'warn', text: 'Give each person their statement by ' + C.d(C.ieStatementBy(v.payout), 'long') + ', within 10 days of payout.' });
    r.people.forEach(function (p) {
      if (p.share <= 0) return;
      if (v.country === 'IE' && p.type === 'Owner or manager') out.push({ kind: 'warn', text: p.name + ' is an owner or manager. In Ireland they can only share in card tips if they regularly do the same work as the others, and only a fair share.' });
      if (v.country === 'GB' && p.type === 'Self-employed') out.push({ kind: 'warn', text: p.name + ' is self-employed. The UK tips law covers workers and agency workers, not the self-employed. You can still include them.' });
    });
    if (locked) out.push({ kind: 'warn', text: r.sharers + ' people share in this period. Free covers up to 5. Upgrade to see each share.' });
    return out;
  }
  function savedLine(v) {
    return C.d(v.from, 'my') + ' is saved in the Record sheet.' + (v.country === 'NI' ? '' : ' Keep it until ' + C.d(C.addYears(v.payout, 3)) + '.');
  }

  /* ---------- statements (5.7) ---------- */
  function how(r, p, v) {
    var g = r.groups.filter(function (x) { return x.name === p.group; })[0], who = v.groupsOn ? g.name : 'Everyone', of = v.groupsOn ? 'the ' + g.name + '\'s' : 'the team\'s';
    var on = g.people.filter(function (x) { return x.w > 0; });
    var H = on.reduce(function (a, x) { return a + x.h; }, 0) / 100, P = on.reduce(function (a, x) { return a + x.p; }, 0) / 100;
    var HP = on.reduce(function (a, x) { return a + x.h * x.p; }, 0) / 10000, h = p.h / 100, pt = p.p / 100;
    var lead = v.groupsOn ? who + ' shares ' + num(g.pct) + '% of the tips, ' : 'Tips are shared ';
    if (v.groupsOn && g.method === 'Equal') lead = who + ' shares ' + num(g.pct) + '% of the tips ';
    if (r.days) lead = lead.replace(/, $/, ' ') + 'day by day, ';
    switch (g.method) {
      case 'Hours': return [lead + 'by hours worked.', 'You worked ' + num(h) + ' of ' + of + ' ' + num(H) + ' hours.'];
      case 'Points': return [lead + 'by points.', 'You have ' + num(pt) + ' of ' + of + ' ' + num(P) + ' points.'];
      case 'Equal': return [lead + 'equally.', 'You are one of ' + on.length + ' people sharing.'];
      default: return [lead + 'by hours worked times points.', 'You worked ' + num(h) + ' hours at ' + num(pt) + ' points: ' + num(h * pt) + ' of ' + of + ' ' + num(HP) + '.'];
    }
  }
  // The same two lines in the statement's language (i18n howWords). Returns null for English.
  function howIn(r, p, v, lang) {
    var t = lang !== 'English' && W[lang] && W[lang].howWords;
    if (!t) return null;
    var g = r.groups.filter(function (x) { return x.name === p.group; })[0], on = g.people.filter(function (x) { return x.w > 0; });
    var H = on.reduce(function (a, x) { return a + x.h; }, 0) / 100, P = on.reduce(function (a, x) { return a + x.p; }, 0) / 100;
    var HP = on.reduce(function (a, x) { return a + x.h * x.p; }, 0) / 10000, h = p.h / 100, pt = p.p / 100;
    var k = g.method === 'Hours \u00d7 points' ? 'HP' : g.method;
    var f = { g: v.groupsOn ? g.name : t.team, pct: num(g.pct), m: t[k], d: r.days ? t.day : '', h: num(h), H: num(H), pt: num(pt), P: num(P), x: num(h * pt), HP: num(HP), n: on.length };
    function fill(s) { return s.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, function (a, x) { return f[x]; }); }
    return [fill(v.groupsOn ? t.gs : t.all), fill(t['y' + k])];
  }
  // One A4 statement. Only this person's share and the venue's total: never anyone else's amount.
  function statement(r, p, v, staff) {
    var lang = W[staff && staff.lang] ? staff.lang : 'English', w = W[lang], en = lang === 'English' ? null : W.English;
    function L(k) { return esc(sub(w[k], v)) + (en ? '<i>' + esc(sub(en[k], v)) + '</i>' : ''); }
    var c = cur(v), foot = v.country === 'IE' ? ['taxIE'] : ['taxUK', v.contact ? 'ask' : 'askNone'];
    var agency = staff && staff.type === 'Agency worker' && staff.agency ? '<dt>' + L('agency') + '</dt><dd>' + esc(staff.agency) + '</dd>' : '';
    return '<article class="tf-page a-st" lang="' + ({ English: 'en', Spanish: 'es', Polish: 'pl', Portuguese: 'pt', Romanian: 'ro', Italian: 'it' })[lang] + '">' +
      '<div class="hd"><b>' + esc(v.venue) + '</b><span>' + L('title') + '</span></div><div class="bd"><dl>' +
      '<dt>' + L('name') + '</dt><dd>' + esc(p.full) + '</dd>' + agency +
      '<dt>' + L('period') + '</dt><dd>' + C.d(v.from, 'long') + (lang === 'English' ? ' to ' : ' \u2013 ') + C.d(v.to, 'long') + '</dd>' +
      '<dt>' + L('paid') + '</dt><dd>' + C.d(v.payout, 'long') + '</dd>' +
      '<dt>' + L('total') + '</dt><dd>' + C.money(r.T, c) + '</dd>' +
      '<dt>' + L('tronc') + '</dt><dd>' + C.money(r.R, c) + '</dd></dl>' +
      '<div class="sh"><span>' + L('share') + '</span><b>' + C.money(p.share, c) + '</b></div>' +
      '<div class="how"><h4>' + L('how') + '</h4>' + howLines(r, p, v, lang) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="ft">' + foot.map(function (k) { return '<p>' + L(k) + '</p>'; }).join('') + '</div></div></article>';
  }
  function howLines(r, p, v, lang) {
    var en = how(r, p, v), loc = howIn(r, p, v, lang);
    return en.map(function (x, i) { return '<p>' + (loc ? esc(loc[i]) + '<i>' + esc(x) + '</i>' : esc(x)) + '</p>'; }).join('');
  }
  function statements(r, v, staffByName, only) {
    return r.people.filter(function (p) { return p.share > 0 && (!only || p.name === only); })
      .map(function (p) { return statement(r, p, v, staffByName[p.name]); }).join('');
  }

  /* ---------- reply letter (5.8) ---------- */
  // L = Core.letterRows(...). req = {worker (full name), on, m1, m2}
  function letter(L, req, v) {
    var c = cur(v), ni = v.country === 'NI';
    function mo(x) { return C.money(x, c); }
    var body = L.rows.map(function (x) {
      return '<tr><td>' + C.d(x.month + '-01', 'mY') + '</td><td>' + mo(x.total) + '</td><td>' + mo(x.toWorkers) + '</td><td>' + mo(x.tronc) + '</td><td>' + mo(x.share) + '</td></tr>';
    }).join('');
    var range = C.d(req.m1 + '-01', 'my') + ' to ' + C.d(req.m2 + '-01', 'my');
    return '<article class="tf-page tf-doc"><p class="tf-dv">' + esc(v.venue) + '</p><p>' + C.d(req.on, 'long') + '</p>' +
      '<p>Dear ' + esc(req.worker) + ',</p>' +
      (ni ? '<h2>Tips summary</h2><p>Here are the tips from ' + range + '.</p>'
        : '<h2>Your request for tips records</h2><p>You asked on ' + C.d(req.on, 'long') + ' for the records of tips from ' + range + '. Here they are.</p>') +
      '<table><thead><tr><th>Month paid</th><th>Tips at ' + esc(v.venue) + '</th><th>To workers</th><th>Through tronc</th><th>Your share</th></tr></thead><tbody>' + body +
      '</tbody><tfoot><tr><td>Total</td><td>' + mo(L.sum.total) + '</td><td>' + mo(L.sum.toWorkers) + '</td><td>' + mo(L.sum.tronc) + '</td><td>' + mo(L.sum.share) + '</td></tr></tfoot></table>' +
      (L.sum.total ? '' : '<p>No tips were paid in these months.</p>') +
      (L.later || []).map(function (b) {
        var span = b.from.slice(0, 7) === b.to.slice(0, 7) ? C.d(b.to, 'my') : C.d(b.from, 'long') + ' to ' + C.d(b.to, 'long');
        return '<p>Tips for ' + span + ' are paid on ' + C.d(b.paid, 'long') + ', so they will appear under ' + C.d(b.paid, 'my') + '.</p>';
      }).join('') +
      '<p>These are the total tips received at ' + esc(v.venue) + ' and your own share. We don\'t share other people\'s amounts.</p>' +
      '<p class="tf-sig">' + esc(v.contact) + '</p></article>';
  }

  /* ---------- policy (5.9, s27I) ---------- */
  var ASK = { no: 'No. Tips are up to the customer.', encourage: 'We encourage customers to tip, but it is always up to them.', service: 'We add a service charge to the bill. Customers can ask us to remove it.' };
  var METHOD_WORDS = { 'Equal': 'equally', 'Hours': 'by hours worked', 'Points': 'by points', 'Hours \u00d7 points': 'by hours worked times points' };
  function ruleWords(o, pointsMean) {
    var pts = '';
    var s = o.groupsOn ? o.groups.map(function (g, i) {
      return (i ? g.name + ' staff share ' + num(g.pct) + '% ' : g.name + ' staff share ' + num(g.pct) + '% of tips ') + METHOD_WORDS[g.method] + '.';
    }).join(' ') : 'Tips are shared between all staff ' + METHOD_WORDS[o.method] + '.';
    var usesPoints = (o.groupsOn ? o.groups.map(function (g) { return g.method; }) : [o.method]).some(function (m) { return /Points|points/.test(m); });
    if (usesPoints && pointsMean) pts = ' Points stand for ' + pointsMean.replace(/\.$/, '') + '.';
    return s + pts + (o.pool === 'day' ? ' Tips are shared day by day, among the staff who worked that day.' : '');
  }
  // a = form answers: {ask, ways:[...], who, when, consultOn, consultHow, said, contact, pointsMean, today}
  function policy(o, a, v) {
    var ways = (a.ways && a.ways.length ? a.ways : ['Card', 'Cash']).map(function (x) { return x.toLowerCase(); });
    var waysTxt = ways.length > 1 ? ways.slice(0, -1).join(', ') + ' or ' + ways[ways.length - 1] : ways[0];
    var S = [
      ['What counts as a tip here', 'Any tip, gratuity or service charge a customer pays by ' + waysTxt + '.'],
      ['Do we ask customers to tip?', ASK[a.ask] || ASK.no],
      ['Who shares', a.who + '.'],
      ['How shares are worked out', ruleWords(o, a.pointsMean)],
      ['When tips are paid', a.when + '.'],
      ['Card fees', '100% of tips go to staff. We keep nothing for card fees.']
    ];
    if (o.tronc > 0 || a.tronc) S.push(['Tronc', 'Part of the tips is paid through a tronc operator, who decides how that part is shared.']);
    S.push(['Your records', 'You can ask ' + a.contact + ' for the records of your tips. We\'ll reply within 4 weeks.']);
    S.push(['How we asked staff', 'We asked staff for their views by ' + (a.consultHow || 'Meeting').toLowerCase() + ' on ' + C.d(a.consultOn, 'long') + '. What staff said: ' + (a.said || 'no comments.')]);
    S.push(['Dates', 'This policy: ' + C.d(a.today, 'long') + '. Review due by ' + C.d(C.addYears(a.today, 3), 'long') + '.']);
    S.push(['Who to ask', a.contact]);
    return '<article class="tf-page tf-doc"><h1>How we share tips at ' + esc(v.venue) + '</h1>' +
      S.map(function (x) { return '<h3>' + esc(x[0]) + '</h3><p>' + esc(x[1]) + '</p>'; }).join('') +
      '<p class="tf-fine">Made with Tip Fair. This is a template to help you write your own policy, not legal advice.</p></article>';
  }

  /* ---------- notice (5.10, Ireland) ---------- */
  var LAW = 'The law requires that tips and gratuities paid by card or other electronic means are distributed to employees.';
  // a = {card: true|false, how, pct, service: true|false, cash}
  function noticeLines(a) {
    var L = [];
    if (a.card) L.push('We share ' + (a.pct || '100%') + ' of card tips with our staff, ' + a.how.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + a.how.slice(1) + '.');
    else L.push('We don\'t take tips by card.');
    L.push(a.cash === 'Shared the same way' ? 'Cash tips are shared the same way.' : 'Cash tips are kept by the person who receives them.');
    L.push(a.service ? 'Our service charge is shared with staff in the same way as card tips.' : 'We don\'t add a service charge.');
    return L;
  }
  function notice(a, v) {
    var L = noticeLines(a);
    function page(cls) {
      return '<article class="tf-page tf-doc tf-poster ' + cls + '"><p class="tf-dv">' + esc(v.venue) + '</p><h1>Tips and gratuities</h1>' +
        '<p class="tf-big">' + esc(L[0]) + '</p>' + L.slice(1).map(function (x) { return '<p>' + esc(x) + '</p>'; }).join('') +
        '<p class="tf-fine">' + esc(LAW) + '</p></article>';
    }
    return page('tf-a4') + page('tf-a5');
  }
  function noticeText(a, v) { return v.venue + ': tips and gratuities\n\n' + noticeLines(a).join('\n') + '\n\n' + LAW; }

  return { esc: esc, checks: checks, savedLine: savedLine, how: how, statement: statement, statements: statements, letter: letter,
    ruleWords: ruleWords, policy: policy, notice: notice, noticeText: noticeText, LAW: LAW };
})();

/**
 * Tip Fair: shares tips fairly and keeps the records the tips laws ask for.
 * Sheets: Staff, Tips, Hours, Record (+ Shares when written). Settings, mappings and the licence in Document Properties.
 * The maths is in core.js, the documents in docs.js. Nothing here sends data out of the spreadsheet.
 */

function onOpen(e) {
  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().createAddonMenu().addItem('Open Tip Fair', 'showSidebar').addToUi();
}
function onInstall(e) { onOpen(e); }

function showSidebar() {
  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().showSidebar(HtmlService.createTemplate(HTML_FILES_['Sidebar']).evaluate().setTitle('Tip Fair'));
}
function include(name) { return HTML_FILES_[name]; }

function today_() { return Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), ss_().getSpreadsheetTimeZone() || 'Europe/London', 'yyyy-MM-dd'); }
function now_() { return Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), ss_().getSpreadsheetTimeZone() || 'Europe/London', "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"); }
function pro_() { return licenceState_(today_()).pro; }

/** 5.1 */
function setup(country, venue) {
  if (['GB', 'NI', 'IE'].indexOf(country) < 0) throw new Error('Choose where the venue is.');
  saveSettings_({ country: country, venue: String(venue || '').trim().slice(0, 120) || 'My venue' });
  setupSheets_(country);
  return getState();
}

function saveSettings(patch) {
  var keep = {};
  ['venue', 'country', 'contact'].forEach(function (k) { if (patch[k] != null) keep[k] = String(patch[k]).trim().slice(0, 120); });
  if (keep.country && ['GB', 'NI', 'IE'].indexOf(keep.country) < 0) delete keep.country;
  var s = saveSettings_(keep);
  if (keep.country) setNotes_(s.country);
  return getState();
}

function openSheet(name) {
  var sh = ss_().getSheetByName(name);
  if (sh) ss_().setActiveSheet(sh);
}

/** Default period: the month of the latest tip, or last month. Default payout: the 28th of the month after. */
function defaults_(tips, today) {
  var last = tips.reduce(function (a, t) { return t.date > a ? t.date : a; }, '');
  var ym = last ? last.slice(0, 7) : Core.addMonths(today.slice(0, 7), -1);
  return { from: ym + '-01', to: Core.monthEnd(ym + '-01'), payout: Core.addMonths(ym, 1) + '-28' };
}
function groupsFrom_(staff, saved) {
  var names = [];
  staff.forEach(function (s) { if (names.indexOf(s.group) < 0) names.push(s.group); });
  var old = {};
  (saved || []).forEach(function (g) { old[g.name] = g; });
  if (names.every(function (n) { return old[n]; }) && (saved || []).length === names.length) return saved;
  var base = Math.floor(10000 / Math.max(names.length, 1)), extra = 10000 - base * names.length;
  return names.map(function (n, i) { return old[n] || { name: n, pct: (base + (i === 0 ? extra : 0)) / 100, method: 'Hours' }; });
}

/** Everything the home screen (5.2) needs. Counts and totals only. */
function getState() {
  var s = settings_(), today = today_(), lic = licenceState_(today);
  if (!isSetUp_()) return { setUp: false, licence: lic, today: today };
  var st = readStaff_(), tp = readTips_(), hr = readHours_();
  var d = defaults_(tp.tips, today);
  var o = s.work && s.work.from ? s.work : {};
  var from = o.from || d.from, to = o.to || d.to;
  var tt = Core.tipsTotal(tp.tips, from, to);
  var hrs = hr.hours.filter(function (r) { return !r.date || (r.date >= from && r.date <= to); });
  var hTotal = hrs.reduce(function (a, r) { return a + r.hours; }, 0);
  var id = from + '_' + to, blocks = Core.readRecord(recordValues_());
  var fin = blocks.filter(function (b) { return b.id === id && !b.replaced; })[0];
  return {
    setUp: true, today: today, licence: lic,
    settings: { country: s.country, venue: s.venue, contact: s.contact || '' },
    staff: st.staff.map(function (x) { return { name: x.name, group: x.group, points: x.points, type: x.type }; }), badPoints: st.badPoints,
    tips: { total: tt.total, count: tt.count, bad: tp.bad, latest: d.from },
    hours: { total: hTotal, bad: hr.bad },
    work: { from: from, to: to, payout: o.payout || d.payout, groupsOn: o.groupsOn != null ? o.groupsOn : groupsFrom_(st.staff, []).length > 1,
      groups: groupsFrom_(st.staff, o.groups), method: o.method || 'Hours', pool: o.pool || 'period', tronc: o.tronc || 0 },
    finalised: fin ? { at: fin.at, changed: fin.changed } : null,
    records: blocks.filter(function (b) { return !b.replaced; }).length
  };
}

/** 5.4 */
function checkHours(from, to) {
  var st = readStaff_(), hr = readHours_();
  var r = Core.checkHours(st.staff, hr.hours, from, to, Core.d(from, 'm'));
  r.bad = hr.bad;
  return r;
}

/** 5.3: the sidebar parses the CSV and sends the tips it found. They are checked again here. */
function importTips(tips, mapping) {
  var clean = [];
  (tips || []).forEach(function (t) {
    var date = Core.parseDate(t.date), amount = typeof t.amount === 'number' ? Math.round(t.amount) : Core.parseAmount(t.amount, false);
    if (!date || amount == null) return;
    clean.push({ date: date, amount: amount, type: Core.TYPES.indexOf(t.type) > -1 ? t.type : 'Card', vat: Math.round(Number(t.vat) || 0),
      source: String(t.source || '').slice(0, 60), ref: String(t.ref || '').slice(0, 80) });
  });
  if (mapping && mapping.key && /^map:/.test(mapping.key)) {
    PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().setProperty(mapping.key, JSON.stringify({ map: mapping.map, source: String(mapping.source || '').slice(0, 60), order: mapping.order || '' }));
  }
  return appendTips_(clean);
}
function getMapping(key) {
  if (!/^map:/.test(key)) return null;
  var raw = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().getProperty(key);
  return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
}

/** The split settings from the sidebar, kept so the next month starts from them. */
function cleanWork_(w) {
  var o = { from: Core.parseDate(w.from), to: Core.parseDate(w.to), payout: Core.parseDate(w.payout), groupsOn: !!w.groupsOn,
    method: Core.METHODS.indexOf(w.method) > -1 ? w.method : 'Hours', pool: w.pool === 'day' ? 'day' : 'period', tronc: Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(w.tronc) || 0)),
    groups: (w.groups || []).map(function (g) { return { name: String(g.name), pct: Number(g.pct) || 0, method: Core.METHODS.indexOf(g.method) > -1 ? g.method : 'Hours' }; }) };
  if (!o.from || !o.to || o.from > o.to) throw new Error('Choose the period again.');
  if (!o.payout) throw new Error('Choose the payout date.');
  return o;
}
function compute_(w) {
  var o = cleanWork_(w), st = readStaff_();
  saveSettings_({ work: o });
  o.tips = readTips_().tips; o.staff = st.staff; o.hours = readHours_().hours;
  return { o: o, r: Core.split(o), staff: st.staff };
}
function view_(o) {
  var s = settings_();
  return { country: s.country, venue: s.venue, contact: s.contact || '', from: o.from, to: o.to, payout: o.payout, groupsOn: o.groupsOn };
}

/** 5.5 \u2192 5.6. Over 5 people without Pro, only group totals come back (6.10). */
function work(w) {
  var c = compute_(w), r = c.r;
  if (!r.ok) return { ok: false, error: r.error };
  var lock = Core.locked(r, pro_()), v = view_(c.o);
  var id = c.o.from + '_' + c.o.to, fin = Core.readRecord(recordValues_()).filter(function (b) { return b.id === id && !b.replaced; })[0];
  return {
    ok: true, locked: lock, T: r.T, R: r.R, Tsplit: r.Tsplit, byType: r.byType, count: r.count, sharers: r.sharers,
    groups: r.groups.map(function (g) {
      return { name: g.name, pct: g.pct, method: g.method, pot: g.pot, n: g.people.filter(function (p) { return p.share > 0; }).length,
        people: lock ? [] : g.people.map(function (p) { return { name: p.full, h: p.h, p: p.p, share: p.share }; }) };
    }),
    checks: Docs.checks(r, v, lock), saved: fin ? Docs.savedLine(v) : null, finalisedAt: fin ? fin.at : null
  };
}

/** 6.8 */
function finalise(w, note) {
  var c = compute_(w), r = c.r;
  if (!r.ok) return { ok: false, error: r.error };
  if (Core.locked(r, pro_())) return { ok: false, code: 'PRO' };
  var rows = Core.recordRows(r, c.o, c.o.payout, now_());
  if (note) rows[0][20] = String(note).slice(0, 200);
  writeRecord_(rows, c.o.from + '_' + c.o.to, today_());
  return { ok: true, saved: Docs.savedLine(view_(c.o)) };
}

function writeShares(w) {
  var c = compute_(w), r = c.r;
  if (!r.ok) return { ok: false, error: r.error };
  if (Core.locked(r, pro_())) return { ok: false, code: 'PRO' };
  writeSharesSheet_(r, settings_().venue + ': tip shares, ' + Core.d(c.o.from, 'long') + ' to ' + Core.d(c.o.to, 'long'));
  return { ok: true };
}

/** 5.8: finalised periods and the names in them, for the Records screen. */
function getRecords() {
  var blocks = Core.readRecord(recordValues_()), names = [];
  blocks.forEach(function (b) { if (!b.replaced) b.rows.forEach(function (r) { if (names.indexOf(r[12]) < 0) names.push(r[12]); }); });
  return {
    blocks: blocks.map(function (b) { return { id: b.id, from: b.from, to: b.to, paid: b.paid, total: b.total, at: b.at, people: b.rows.length, changed: b.changed, replaced: b.replaced, status: b.status }; }).reverse(),
    names: names.sort()
  };
}
function checkRequest(on, m1, m2) { return Core.requestRange(on, m1, m2); }

/**
 * Documents open in a print dialog (7). 'one' is free while the period isn't locked; the rest need Pro (6.10).
 * kind: 'one' {w, name} | 'all' {w} | 'letter' {worker, on, m1, m2} | 'policy' {w, a} | 'notice' {a}
 */
function print(kind, x) {
  var s = settings_(), html, title;
  if (kind !== 'one' && !pro_()) return { ok: false, code: 'PRO' };
  if (kind === 'one' || kind === 'all') {
    var c = compute_(x.w), r = c.r;
    if (!r.ok) return { ok: false, error: r.error };
    if (Core.locked(r, pro_())) return { ok: false, code: 'PRO' };
    var by = {};
    c.staff.forEach(function (p) { by[p.name] = p; });
    var only = kind === 'one' ? (r.people.filter(function (p) { return p.full === x.name; })[0] || {}).name : null;
    if (kind === 'one' && !only) return { ok: false, error: 'Choose a name from the list.' };
    html = Docs.statements(r, view_(c.o), by, only);
    title = kind === 'one' ? 'Statement' : 'Statements';
  } else if (kind === 'letter') {
    var q = Core.requestRange(x.on, x.m1, x.m2);
    if (q.errors.length) return { ok: false, error: q.errors[0].text };
    var L = Core.letterRows(Core.readRecord(recordValues_()), x.worker, x.m1, x.m2);
    html = Docs.letter(L, x, { country: s.country, venue: s.venue, contact: s.contact || '' });
    title = 'Reply letter';
  } else if (kind === 'policy') {
    var o = cleanWork_(x.w);
    x.a.today = today_();
    html = Docs.policy(o, x.a, { venue: s.venue });
    title = 'Tipping policy';
  } else if (kind === 'notice') {
    html = Docs.notice(x.a, { venue: s.venue });
    title = 'Tips notice';
  } else throw new Error('Unknown document');
  var t = HtmlService.createTemplate(HTML_FILES_['Print']);
  t.data = html;
  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().showModalDialog(t.evaluate().setWidth(860).setHeight(640), title);
  return { ok: true };
}

/** 5.10: the notice as text to copy to a website. */
function noticeText(a) {
  if (!pro_()) return { ok: false, code: 'PRO' };
  return { ok: true, text: Docs.noticeText(a, { venue: settings_().venue }) };
}

/**
 * Tip Fair: reading and writing the sheets. One getValues() and one setValues() per operation.
 * Every text value is written through Core.safeText, so a name can't become a formula.
 * Logs never hold row data.
 */

var SHEETS = { staff: 'Staff', tips: 'Tips', hours: 'Hours', record: 'Record', shares: 'Shares' };
var HEADERS = {
  Staff: ['Name', 'Group', 'Points', 'Type', 'Agency', 'Statement language', 'Notes'],
  Tips: ['Date', 'Amount', 'Type', 'VAT part', 'Source', 'Reference'],
  Hours: ['Date', 'Name', 'Hours'],
  Record: Core.RECORD_COLS,
  Shares: ['Name', 'Group', 'Hours', 'Points', 'Share']
};

function ss_() { return SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet(); }

/** Settings live in Document Properties, so they travel with the spreadsheet. */
function settings_() {
  var raw = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().getProperty('tf');
  return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
}
function saveSettings_(patch) {
  var s = settings_();
  Object.keys(patch).forEach(function (k) { s[k] = patch[k]; });
  PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().setProperty('tf', JSON.stringify(s));
  return s;
}

function isSetUp_() {
  var ss = ss_();
  return !!settings_().country && ['Staff', 'Tips', 'Hours', 'Record'].every(function (n) { return !!ss.getSheetByName(n); });
}

/** 5.1: adds the four sheets. Safe to run again: sheets that exist keep their data. */
function setupSheets_(country) {
  var ss = ss_(), first = null;
  ['Staff', 'Tips', 'Hours', 'Record'].forEach(function (name) {
    var sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
    if (!sh) {
      sh = ss.insertSheet(name);
      sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, HEADERS[name].length).setValues([HEADERS[name]]).setFontWeight('bold');
      sh.setFrozenRows(1);
      if (name === 'Record') {
        // Plain text, so amounts and dates read back exactly as written and the fingerprint holds.
        sh.getRange(1, 1, sh.getMaxRows(), HEADERS.Record.length).setNumberFormat('@');
        sh.protect().setWarningOnly(true).setDescription('Written by Tip Fair');
      }
      if (name === 'Staff') {
        sh.getRange(2, 4, 500, 1).setDataValidation(SpreadsheetApp.newDataValidation().requireValueInList(Core.STAFF_TYPES, true).setAllowInvalid(true).build());
        sh.getRange(2, 6, 500, 1).setDataValidation(SpreadsheetApp.newDataValidation().requireValueInList(Core.LANGS, true).setAllowInvalid(true).build());
      }
      if (name === 'Tips') sh.getRange(2, 3, 5000, 1).setDataValidation(SpreadsheetApp.newDataValidation().requireValueInList(Core.TYPES, true).setAllowInvalid(true).build());
      if (name === 'Hours') sh.getRange(2, 3, 5000, 1).setNumberFormat('0.00');
      if (!first) first = sh;
    }
  });
  setNotes_(country);
  if (first) ss.setActiveSheet(ss.getSheetByName('Staff'));
}

/** Header notes (4). They follow the country, so changing it in Settings updates them. */
function setNotes_(country) {
  var ss = ss_(), tips = ss.getSheetByName('Tips'), rec = ss.getSheetByName('Record');
  if (tips) {
    tips.getRange(1, 2).setNote('What the customer paid as a tip, before any card fees. Don\'t take card fees off.');
    tips.getRange(1, 4).setNote('Only if this amount includes VAT, such as some service charges. Leave blank otherwise.');
    tips.getRange(1, 3).setNote(country === 'IE' ? 'In Ireland a service charge counts as an electronic tip and is shared like one.' : '');
  }
  if (rec) rec.getRange(1, 1).setNote(country === 'NI' ? 'Written by Tip Fair.' : 'Written by Tip Fair. Keep for 3 years from each payout.');
}

function rows_(name) {
  var sh = ss_().getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sh) return [];
  var n = sh.getLastRow() - 1, c = HEADERS[name].length;
  return n > 0 ? sh.getRange(2, 1, n, c).getValues() : [];
}
function str_(v) { return v == null ? '' : String(v).trim(); }

/** Staff, from the Staff sheet. Name is used everywhere, so Hours must match it. */
function readStaff_() {
  var out = [], bad = [], seen = {};
  rows_('Staff').forEach(function (r) {
    var name = str_(r[0]);
    if (!name || seen[name]) return;
    seen[name] = 1;
    var p = Core.parsePoints(r[2]);
    if (p == null) { bad.push(name); p = 100; }
    var type = str_(r[3]), lang = str_(r[5]);
    out.push({ name: name, full: name, group: str_(r[1]) || 'Staff', points: p, type: Core.STAFF_TYPES.indexOf(type) > -1 ? type : 'Worker',
      agency: str_(r[4]), lang: Core.LANGS.indexOf(lang) > -1 ? lang : 'English' });
  });
  return { staff: out, badPoints: bad };
}

function readTips_() {
  var out = [], bad = 0;
  rows_('Tips').forEach(function (r) {
    if (r[0] === '' && r[1] === '') return;
    var date = Core.parseDate(r[0]), amount = Core.parseAmount(r[1], false), vat = r[3] === '' ? 0 : Core.parseAmount(r[3], false);
    if (!date || amount == null || vat == null) { bad++; return; }
    var type = str_(r[2]);
    out.push({ date: date, amount: amount, type: Core.TYPES.indexOf(type) > -1 ? type : 'Card', vat: vat, source: str_(r[4]), ref: str_(r[5]) });
  });
  return { tips: out, bad: bad };
}

function readHours_() {
  var out = [], bad = 0;
  rows_('Hours').forEach(function (r) {
    var name = str_(r[1]);
    if (!name) return;
    var h = Core.parseHours(r[2]), date = r[0] === '' ? null : Core.parseDate(r[0]);
    if (h == null || (r[0] !== '' && !date)) { bad++; return; }
    out.push({ date: date, name: name, hours: h });
  });
  return { hours: out, bad: bad };
}

/** 5.3: appends imported tips under the last row, skipping ones already there. */
function appendTips_(incoming) {
  var have = readTips_().tips, d = Core.dedupe(have, incoming);
  if (d.tips.length) {
    var sh = ss_().getSheetByName('Tips');
    var vals = d.tips.map(function (t) {
      return [t.date, Core.plain(t.amount), t.type || 'Card', t.vat ? Core.plain(t.vat) : '', Core.safeText(t.source), Core.safeText(t.ref)];
    });
    var range = sh.getRange(sh.getLastRow() + 1, 1, vals.length, 6);
    range.setValues(vals.map(function (r) { return [toDate_(r[0]), Number(r[1]), r[2], r[3] === '' ? '' : Number(r[3]), r[4], r[5]]; }));
    sh.getRange(range.getRow(), 1, vals.length, 1).setNumberFormat('d mmm yyyy');
    sh.getRange(range.getRow(), 2, vals.length, 1).setNumberFormat('0.00');
  }
  return { added: d.tips.length, skipped: d.skipped };
}
function toDate_(iso) { return new Date(+iso.slice(0, 4), +iso.slice(5, 7) - 1, +iso.slice(8, 10)); }

/** The Record sheet as text, from row 2. */
function recordValues_() {
  var sh = ss_().getSheetByName('Record');
  if (!sh) return [];
  var n = sh.getLastRow() - 1;
  return n > 0 ? sh.getRange(2, 1, n, HEADERS.Record.length).getDisplayValues() : [];
}

/** 6.8: adds a finalised block. An earlier block for the same period is marked Replaced, never deleted. */
function writeRecord_(rows, id, today) {
  var sh = ss_().getSheetByName('Record'), old = recordValues_(), stamp = 'Replaced on ' + Core.d(today);
  var all = old.map(function (r) {
    var x = r.slice();
    if (x[0] === id && !/^Replaced/.test(x[21])) x[21] = stamp;
    return x;
  }).concat(rows);
  all = all.map(function (r) { return r.map(Core.safeText); });
  sh.getRange(2, 1, all.length, HEADERS.Record.length).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(all);
}

/** "Write shares to sheet": a Shares sheet for payroll, replaced each time. */
function writeSharesSheet_(r, title) {
  var ss = ss_(), sh = ss.getSheetByName('Shares') || ss.insertSheet('Shares');
  sh.clearContents();
  var vals = [[Core.safeText(title), '', '', '', ''], HEADERS.Shares];
  r.people.forEach(function (p) { vals.push([Core.safeText(p.full), Core.safeText(p.group), Core.hundredths(p.h), Core.hundredths(p.p), p.share / 100]); });
  sh.getRange(1, 1, vals.length, 5).setValues(vals);
  sh.getRange(1, 1, 2, 5).setFontWeight('bold');
  sh.getRange(3, 5, Math.max(r.people.length, 1), 1).setNumberFormat('0.00');
  sh.setFrozenRows(2);
  ss.setActiveSheet(sh);
}

/**
 * Tip Fair licence (6.11). The sidebar talks to Freemius itself, so the add-on needs no
 * external_request scope. This file keeps the result in Document Properties and decides Pro from it.
 * Only the uid, the key and the title "Tip Fair" ever leave the sheet.
 */

/** Freemius product, made at launch in the Facilo store (21741). */
var LICENCE = { productId: '44992', apiBase: 'https://api.freemius.com/v1', title: 'Tip Fair' };

function lic_() {
  var raw = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().getProperty('tfLicence');
  return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
}
function saveLic_(l) { PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().setProperty('tfLicence', JSON.stringify(l)); }

/** What the rest of the add-on asks: is Pro on today? */
function licenceState_(today) {
  var l = lic_(), st;
  if (!l.key) return { pro: false, status: 'none', hasKey: false, productId: LICENCE.productId };
  if (l.status === 'ok') {
    var expired = l.expires && l.expires < today, left = Core.GRACE_DAYS - Core.daysBetween(l.lastGood || today, today);
    st = { pro: !expired && (l.lastFail ? left > 0 : true), status: expired ? 'expired' : 'ok', expires: l.expires || null, left: Math.max(0, left) };
  } else st = { pro: false, status: l.status || 'wrong', expires: l.expires || null };
  st.hasKey = true;
  st.keyEnd = l.key.slice(-4);
  st.needsCheck = l.status === 'ok' && (!l.lastCheck || l.lastCheck < today);
  st.productId = LICENCE.productId;
  return st;
}

/** What the sidebar sends to Freemius. */
function licenceRequest(key) {
  var l = lic_();
  return { ok: !!LICENCE.productId, uid: Core.uid(ss_().getId()), key: String(key || l.key || '').trim(), installId: l.installId || '',
    productId: LICENCE.productId, apiBase: LICENCE.apiBase, title: LICENCE.title };
}

/**
 * Stores what Freemius said. result.status: 'ok' | 'wrong' | 'used' | 'expired' | 'cancelled' | 'offline'.
 * Offline keeps Pro for 14 days from the last good check (Core.GRACE_DAYS).
 */
function recordLicence(result) {
  var l = lic_(), today = today_();
  if (result.status === 'ok') {
    l = { key: result.key || l.key, installId: String(result.installId || l.installId || ''), status: 'ok', expires: result.expires ? String(result.expires).slice(0, 10) : null, lastGood: today, lastCheck: today };
  } else if (result.status === 'offline') {
    if (l.status === 'ok') { l.lastFail = today; l.lastCheck = today; }
  } else if (result.status === 'expired' || result.status === 'cancelled') {
    l.status = result.status; l.lastCheck = today;
    if (result.expires) l.expires = String(result.expires).slice(0, 10);
  } else {
    // A wrong key typed over a working one doesn't switch Pro off.
    if (l.key && l.status === 'ok' && result.key && result.key !== l.key) return { pro: licenceState_(today).pro, status: result.status, hasKey: true };
    l = { key: result.key || l.key, installId: l.installId || '', status: result.status || 'wrong', expires: l.expires || null, lastCheck: today };
  }
  saveLic_(l);
  return licenceState_(today);
}

Set them on the Staff sheet.</p>' +\n        '<div class=\"tf-kv\"><span>Pool</span><span class=\"tf-radio2\"><label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"pool\" data-k=\"w.pool\" value=\"period\"' + (w.pool !== 'day' ? Free covers up to 5.') + upgradeCard();\n      else {\n        if (st.pick == null || names.indexOf(st.pick) < 0) st.pick = names[0];\n        b += btn('Print all statements' + pro(), 'printall') +\n          '<p class=\"tf-lbl\">Or print one</p><div class=\"tf-pair\">' + sel('pick', names, st.pick) + btn('Print', 'printone', { sec: 1 }) + '</div>' +\n          '<p class=\"tf-small\">Each statement shows the venue\\'s total and that person\\'s own share. '' : '<p class=\"tf-small\">Reply by ' + esc(C.d(rr.replyBy, 'long')) + '</p>') +\n        '<p class=\"tf-links\"><button class=\"tf-link\" data-go=\"tab:Record\">Open the Record sheet</button></p>';\n      return head('Home', 1) + '<div class=\"tf-sb\">' + msgs() + b + '</div>';\n    },\n    policy: function () {\n      var a = st.pol;\n      function radio(k, v, label) { return '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + k + '\" data-k=\"pol.' + k + '\" value=\"' + v + '\"' + (a[k] === v ? ' checked' : '') + '> ' + label + '</label>'; }\n      var b = '<p class=\"tf-t\">Your tipping policy</p><p class=\"tf-small\">Staff must be able to see your written policy. 'sk_\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022' + esc(L.keyEnd) : 'sk_\u2026') + '\" autocomplete=\"off\">' + btn('Activate', 'activate', { sec: 1 }) + '</span></div>';\n      if (L.pro) b += line('ok', 'Pro active' + (L.expires && L.expires < '2999' ? Pro stays on for ' + L.left + ' more days.' : ''));\n      else if (L.status === 'expired' || L.status === 'cancelled') b += line('warn', 'Your Pro licence has ended. ' person' : ' people') + '</td><td class=\"a-s\">\u2022\u2022\u2022</td></tr>';\n      g.people.forEach(function (p) {\n        h += '<tr class=\"' + (p.share > 0 ? '' : 'a-z') + '\"><td>' + esc(p.name) + '</td><td>' + esc(C.hundredths(p.h)) + '</td><td>' + esc(C.hundredths(p.p)) + '</td><td class=\"a-s\">' + m(p.share) + '</td></tr>';\n      });\n    });\n    return h + '</tbody><tfoot><tr><td colspan=\"3\">Total</td><td>' + m(r.Tsplit) + '</td></tr></tfoot></table>';\n  }\n  function upgradeCard() {\n    return '<div class=\"tf-up\"><p class=\"tf-upt\">Tip Fair Pro</p><p>For venues with more than 5 people sharing tips.</p><ul>' +\n      ['Unlimited staff', 'Print every statement at once, in 6 languages', 'Reply to record requests in a minute', 'Write your tipping policy, or your Irish tips notice']\n        .map(function (x) { return '<li>' + ICON.ok + '<span>' + x + '</span></li>'; }).join('') + '</ul>' +\n      '<p class=\"tf-price\">' + (S.settings.country === 'IE' ? '\u20ac7 a month or \u20ac69 a year per venue.' : '\u00a36 a month or \u00a359 a year per venue.') + ' Cancel anytime.</p>' +\n      '<button class=\"tf-btn tf-gold\" data-go=\"buy\">Get Pro</button><p class=\"tf-small\">Already have a key? <button class=\"tf-link\" data-go=\"settings\">Enter it in Settings.</button></p></div>';\n  }\n\n  function draw() {\n    app.innerHTML = SCREENS[st.screen]();\n    app.querySelectorAll('button[data-go]').forEach(function (b) { if (st.busy) b.disabled = true; });\n  }\n  function go(screen) { st.msg = null; st.screen = screen; draw(); app.scrollTop = 0; }\n\n  /** Server calls. A failure shows the error in the sidebar and never leaves a screen stuck. */\n  function call(fn, args, ok) {\n    st.busy = true; draw();\n    var run = google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function (x) { st.busy = false; ok(x); draw(); }).withFailureHandler(function (e) {\n      st.busy = false;\n      st.msg = { kind: 'warn', text: (e && e.message) || 'Something went wrong. Try again.' };\n      draw();\n    });\n    run[fn].apply(run, args || []);\n  }\n  function load(state) {\n    S = state;\n    if (!S.setUp) { st.screen = 'first'; return; }\n    st.w = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(S.work));\n    st.set = { venue: S.settings.venue, country: S.settings.country, contact: S.settings.contact };\n    if (st.screen === 'loading' || st.screen === 'first') st.screen = 'home';\n  }\n  function proOr(res, then) {\n    if (res && res.code === 'PRO') return go('upgrade');\n    if (res && res.ok === false) { st.msg = { kind: 'warn', text: res.error }; return; }\n    if (then) then(res);\n  }\n\n  /* ---------- CSV import (6.12): parsed here, only the tips go to the server ---------- */\n  function readCsv(file) {\n    st.msg = null; st.imported = null;\n    if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) { st.msg = { kind: 'warn', text: 'That file is over 5 MB. Export a shorter period.' }; return draw(); }\n    var fr = new FileReader();\n    fr.onload = function () {\n      var p = C.parseCsv(String(fr.result));\n      if (!p.ok) { st.msg = { kind: 'warn', text: p.error }; st.csv = null; return draw(); }\n      var key = C.mappingKey(p.headers), auto = C.detectColumns(p.headers);\n      st.csv = { p: p, key: key, map: auto, source: C.tillName(p.headers), order: '' };\n      call('getMapping', [key], function (saved) {\n        if (saved) { st.csv.map = saved.map; st.csv.source = saved.source; st.csv.order = saved.order || ''; }\n        if (!st.csv.map.found && !saved) { st.screen = 'mapping'; return; }\n        scan();\n      });\n    };\n    fr.readAsText(file);\n  }\n  function scan() {\n    var f = st.csv, r = C.csvTips(f.p, f.map, f.source || 'My till', f.order || '');\n    f.res = r; f.askOrder = false;\n    if (r.ambiguous) {\n      var s = '';\n      f.p.rows.some(function (row) { var v = String(row[f.map.date] || '').trim().replace(/[T ]\\d.*$/, ''); var x = /^(\\d{1,2})[\\/.\\-](\\d{1,2})/.exec(v); if (x && x[1] !== x[2]) { s = v; return true; } return false; });\n      var a = C.parseDate(s, 'dmy'), b = C.parseDate(s, 'mdy');\n      f.askOrder = true; f.sample = s; f.dmy = a ? C.d(a, 'dM') : 'day first'; f.mdy = b ? C.d(b, 'dM') : 'month first';\n    }\n    st.screen = 'import';\n  }\n\n  /* ---------- clicks ---------- */\n  var ACT = {\n    create: function () { call('setup', [st.country, st.venue || ''], load); },\n    home: function () { call('getState', [], function (s) { load(s); go('home'); }); },\n    import: function () { st.csv = null; st.imported = null; go('import'); },\n    mapping: function () { go('mapping'); },\n    remap: function () {\n      var mp = st.csv.map;\n      if (mp.date < 0 || mp.tip < 0) { st.msg = { kind: 'warn', text: 'Choose the date and tip amount columns.' }; return draw(); }\n      st.csv.order = ''; scan(); draw();\n    },\n    order: function (o) { st.csv.order = o; scan(); draw(); },\n    addtips: function () {\n      var f = st.csv;\n      call('importTips', [f.res.tips, { key: f.key, map: f.map, source: f.source || 'My till', order: f.order }], function (res) {\n        st.imported = res.added + (res.added === 1 ? ' tip' : ' tips') + ' added to the Tips sheet.' + (res.skipped ? ' ' + res.skipped + ' tips were already in the sheet and were skipped.' : '');\n        call('getState', [], load);\n      });\n    },\n    hours: function () { st.hours = null; go('hours'); },\n    checkhours: function () { call('checkHours', [st.w.from, st.w.to], function (h) { st.hours = h; }); },\n    split: function () { go('split'); },\n    work: function () {\n      call('work', [st.w], function (r) { st.r = r; st.note = ''; st.screen = 'results'; st.msg = null; });\n    },\n    finalise: function () {\n      call('finalise', [st.w, st.note || ''], function (res) {\n        proOr(res, function () { call('work', [st.w], function (r) { st.r = r; st.msg = null; call('getState', [], load); }); });\n      });\n    },\n    write: function () { call('writeShares', [st.w], function (res) { proOr(res, function () { st.msg = { kind: 'ok', text: 'Shares written to the Shares sheet.' }; }); }); },\n    statements: function () {\n      st.msg = null;\n      if (st.r && st.r.ok) return go('statements');\n      call('work', [st.w], function (r) { st.r = r; st.screen = 'statements'; });\n    },\n    printone: function () { call('print', ['one', { w: st.w, name: st.pick }], function (res) { proOr(res); }); },\n    printall: function () { call('print', ['all', { w: st.w }], function (res) { proOr(res); }); },\n    records: function () {\n      var t = S.today, last = C.addMonths(t.slice(0, 7), -1);\n      st.req = st.req || { worker: '', on: t, m1: C.addMonths(last, -11), m2: last };\n      st.rec = null; go('records');\n      call('getRecords', [], function (R) { st.rec = R; if (R.names.indexOf(st.req.worker) < 0) st.req.worker = R.names[0] || ''; });\n    },\n    letter: function () { call('print', ['letter', { worker: st.req.worker, on: st.req.on, m1: st.req.m1, m2: st.req.m2 }], function (res) { proOr(res); }); },\n    policy: function () {\n      st.pol = st.pol || { ask: 'no', ways: ['Card', 'Cash'], who: WHO[0], when: WHEN[0], consultOn: S.today, consultHow: 'Meeting', said: '', contact: S.settings.contact || '' };\n      go('policy');\n    },\n    printpolicy: function () {\n      var a = st.pol;\n      if (!a.contact.trim()) { st.msg = { kind: 'warn', text: 'Add who staff can ask about tips.' }; return draw(); }\n      call('print', ['policy', { w: st.w, a: { ask: a.ask, ways: a.ways, who: a.who, when: a.when, consultOn: a.consultOn, consultHow: a.consultHow, said: a.said, contact: a.contact, tronc: st.w.tronc > 0 } }], function (res) { proOr(res); });\n    },\n    notice: function () { st.not = st.not || { card: true, how: HOW[0], pct: '100%', service: false, cash: 'Shared the same way' }; st.noticeText = null; go('notice'); },\n    printnotice: function () { call('print', ['notice', { a: st.not }], function (res) { proOr(res); }); },\n    noticetext: function () { call('noticeText', [st.not], function (res) { proOr(res, function (x) { st.noticeText = x.text; }); }); },\n    upgrade: function () { go('upgrade'); },\n    buy: function () { window.open(PRO_URL + '?c=' + (S.settings.country === 'IE' ? 'ie' : 'uk'), '_blank'); },\n    settings: function () { st.key = ''; go('settings'); },\n    savesettings: function () { call('saveSettings', [st.set], function (s) { load(s); st.msg = { kind: 'ok', text: 'Saved.' }; }); },\n    activate: function () {\n      var key = String(st.key || '').trim();\n      if (!/^sk_/.test(key)) { st.msg = { kind: 'warn', text: 'Paste the licence key from your email. It starts with sk_.' }; return draw(); }\n      st.busy = true; draw();\n      Licence.activate(key, function (status) {\n        st.busy = false;\n        call('getState', [], function (s) {\n          load(s);\n          st.msg = status === 'ok' ? { kind: 'ok', text: 'Pro is on. Thank you.' } : { kind: 'warn', text: {\n            used: 'This key is already used in another spreadsheet. Each venue needs its own key.',\n            wrong: 'That key didn\\'t work. Check it against your email and try again.',\n            expired: 'That licence has ended. Renew it, then try again.',\n            offline: 'We couldn\\'t reach the licence server.
